verdict.rationale: Lago's API reference generates a command for every endpoint and exposes an OpenAPI 3.1 schema, suggesting code-snippet style documentation (lago-docs-1, lago-docs-16, lago-probe-3), but there is no evidence of an actual in-browser 'try it' console or live runnable execution against sandbox data. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it-now console with live execution, evidence of multi-language runnable snippets, independent confirmation of the reference's interactivity.
